parameters.name: EndDate
parameters.description:
The end date of the query. The format is **YYYY-MM-DD**.

The default value is the current date.

parameters.name: Keyword
parameters.description: The keyword. The search is performed in \`%KeyWord%\` mode and is case-insensitive.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the response. Valid values:

- **zh** (default): Chinese

- **en**: English

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number. The start value is **1**. The default value is **1**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. The maximum value is **100** and the minimum value is **1**. The default value is **20**.

parameters.name: SearchMode
parameters.description:
The search mode for the keyword. Valid values:

- **LIKE** (default): Fuzzy match

- **EXACT**: Exact match

parameters.name: StartDate
parameters.description:
The start date of the query. The format is **YYYY-MM-DD**.

You can query data from the last 90 days only. The value of `StartDate` must be greater than or equal to the current date minus 90 days.

parameters.name: Threshold
parameters.description: The threshold for the number of requests. This operation returns domain names whose request count is less than or equal to the specified value. For example, if you set this parameter to 100, domain names with 100 or fewer requests are returned. If you do not specify this parameter, all domain names are returned.
